mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.diagram_id, m.user_id, m.session_id, m.client_message_id, m.role, m.content, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM diagram_conversation_message m INNER JOIN diagram d ON d.id = m.diagram_id AND d.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram_conversation_message (diagram_id, user_id, session_id, client_message_id, role, content) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{role}, #{content}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = VALUES(session_id), role = VALUES(role), content = VALUES(content), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
